data.notes: July 2026 is unusually stadium-heavy in Paris, with major Latin, pop, K-pop, rock and electronic festival dates clustered in the first three weekends.

events.title: The Weeknd 2026 at Stade de France
events.summary: The Weeknd is confirmed for four Stade de France concerts on July 8, 10, 11 and 12, 2026. The official Stade de France ticket office lists the July 8 date as the fourth and final added show.

events.title: BTS 2026 at Stade de France
events.summary: BTS are confirmed for two Stade de France concerts on July 17 and 18, 2026. The official Stade de France ticket office bills them as two special dates for the K-pop group’s return.

events.title: Bad Bunny – DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS World Tour
events.summary: Bad Bunny is confirmed for July 4 and 5, 2026 at Paris La Défense Arena, billed as his first performance in France. CHUWI is listed as the opening act.

events.title: System Of A Down with Queens Of The Stone Age and Acid Bath
events.summary: System Of A Down are confirmed at Stade de France on July 2 and July 4, 2026. The Stade de France listing names Queens Of The Stone Age and Acid Bath as special guests.

events.title: Peacock Society 2026
events.summary: Peacock Society is confirmed as an open-air electronic festival on July 10–11, 2026 at Hippodrome Paris-Vincennes. The official lineup page lists artists including Four Tet, Floating Points, Boys Noize b2b SALOME, Channel Tres b2b Busy P, Benga & Flowdan, Palms Trax and Mia Koden.

events.title: Guns N’ Roses – World Tour 2026
events.summary: Guns N’ Roses are confirmed for two Accor Arena shows on July 1 and July 3, 2026. Mammoth is listed as opening act on the venue page.

events.title: Yardland 2026
events.summary: Yardland is confirmed for July 3–5, 2026, with a day-by-day urban music lineup including Niska, Jorja Smith, Skepta and Rema. The festival focuses on rap, R&B, Afro and dancehall-adjacent contemporary popular culture.

events.title: Romeo Santos & Prince Royce – Mejor Tarde Que Nunca Tour
events.summary: Romeo Santos and Prince Royce are confirmed for a joint Accor Arena concert on July 19, 2026. The venue describes it as their first time joining forces in Europe on the Mejor Tarde Que Nunca tour.

events.title: Rhadoo - all night long
events.summary: Romanian minimal figure Rhadoo plays all night long at essaim, a strong pick for travelers following micro-house, minimal and deep techno circuits.

events.title: Def Leppard with special guest Extreme
events.summary: Def Leppard are confirmed at Accor Arena on July 8, 2026, with Extreme as special guest. The venue frames it as Def Leppard’s first Paris show in nearly 30 years.

events.title: BELLE EPOQUE! x HORDE OPEN AIR
events.summary: A 14-hour open-air-to-late-night house session from Belle Epoque, Horde Paris, Fvtvr and Wanderlust, with Jan Blomqvist, Rodriguez Jr., Viken Arman and a broad local support slate.

events.title: la Culottée (Nord + Sud)
events.summary: A heavily watched La Station night split across Nord and Sud rooms with Amina, audio primitive, Rachel Noon, Gay Haze, Fais Le Beau and more.

events.title: Pornceptual: COCKO, Kandelissa, LOLSNAKE, Spacer Woman
events.summary: Berlin-born Pornceptual brings its club-culture, art, fashion and radical self-expression concept to Virage for a Berlin x Paris techno lineup with a mandatory dress code.

events.title: B7KLAN J-Rock Festival
events.summary: B7KLAN J-Rock Festival is confirmed for July 11 and 12, 2026 at Arena Grand Paris, celebrating 20 years of Japanese activities. The organizer-side lineup includes Versailles, MUCC, LM.C and Kizu on July 11, with Moi Dix Mois, D’espairsRay, An Cafe, Jiluka, Azavana and Imperial Age on July 12.

events.title: Dance And Go Home X SBB Paris
events.summary: Touring culture platform Dance and Go Home links with SBB Paris for a diaspora day-to-night party blending Afrobeats, Amapiano, hip-hop, R&B and dancehall.

events.title: tribalism - Freddy K, Hemka
events.summary: A serious techno night at essaim led by Freddy K and Hemka, with the club’s limited-presale/door-ticket format built for heads rather than casual traffic.

events.title: La Clairière: MoBlack, Agoria, CLARAA
events.summary: Afro-house pioneer MoBlack headlines La Clairière alongside Agoria and CLARAA for a deep, travel-ready electronic night in the Bois de Boulogne setting.

events.title: cocoon - Eris Drew, Yaël Ohayon
events.summary: Eris Drew joins Yaël Ohayon at essaim for a high-quality, queer-adjacent electronic night that should appeal to house and techno travelers looking beyond festival programming.

events.title: Vulfpeck 2026
events.summary: Vulfpeck are confirmed for a single Accor Arena show on July 9, 2026. The venue bills the Los Angeles group’s Paris return as a funk-heavy arena date.

events.title: Paris New York Heritage Festival 2026
events.summary: Paris New York Heritage Festival is confirmed for July 3–5, 2026 at Parc André Citroën. The official site describes the event as an EcoVillage built around jazz, soul and funk, with concerts and DJ sets; the full artist program is still marked as forthcoming.
